_instructions: Operator: after enabling Unsubscribe at the bottom of every P2 cold sequence (FC2026 — {AE} Cold - AM and - PM), set each sequence's value to true and add confirmed_at + confirmed_by. While ANY value is missing or false, the pre-load verify will BLOCK.
